title: The Last Chit
summary: Tobin Hask, Thornwick's sexton, keeps the dead's names at the barrow mouth. The Quartermaster in the Muster Hall still issues: knock his men down and he has them up again, re-armed. Tobin is tired of crossing names out twice.

steps.journal: Go down to the Muster Hall, the Old Barrows' third floor, and put down the Quartermaster in its last hall. His broken ranks stand up while he does.

ready: The Quartermaster has handed in his last chit. Tell Tobin Hask at the barrow mouth.
done: Tobin crossed out the Quartermaster once, and closed the book. The Gallery's dead stay down now.
